subject: Audit scope probing and sample requests — ISO/FedRAMP intake
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@acmecorp.com>, audit-team@mountainguard.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Audit scope probing and sample requests — ISO/FedRAMP intake

Hi Elaine / MountainGuard team,

Thanks for kicking off the intake call last week. To make the evidence intake efficient for both sides, can you confirm a few scope and sample-window details so we can map owners and pull artifacts ahead of time? Attached is a lightweight intake template (acme-intake-template.xlsx) with the fields we typically populate.

High-level asks: 
- Scope confirmation: will the assessment be limited to the hosted API (prod) and Dedicated networks, or do you also need our Private (VPC/on-prem) deployment bundle?
- Sample windows: do you require 30/90/180-day log slices for authentication/privilege changes, and do you want live-streamed log extracts or zipped exports?
- Snapshot artifacts: list of preferred file formats (CSV, syslog, Parquet) and maximum file sizes we should prepare.
- Control narratives: do you need control owner attestations signed, or are operational narratives + screenshots sufficient for the first pass?

Internal FYI: Marissa / Karthik — please review the attachment and start thinking about owners for the below control groups: access management, key lifecycle, telemetry retention. I expect some follow-ups about KMS evidence and our snapshot cadence.

Next steps: Elaine, if you can reply with the answers above and any additional sampling constraints by EOD Monday (1/19), we will schedule a 30-minute intake follow-up the week of 1/20 to confirm who owns each artifact.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Principal Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: acme-intake-template.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)

From: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@acmecorp.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: audit-team@mountainguard.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Audit scope probing and sample requests — ISO/FedRAMP intake

Hi Sofia,

Appreciate the template — very helpful. Answers inline: 
- Scope: We require evidence for the hosted API (prod) and Dedicated; Private/VPC components are out of scope for this assessment.
- Sample windows: 90-day windows for logs is our preferred baseline. For authentication/privilege-change events we typically request both the event log slice (CSV or syslog) and the associated request/context (JSON) where available. Zipped exports are fine; files under 500MB preferred — if larger, provide a manifest + direct download link.
- Snapshot artifacts: CSV or gzipped syslog are easiest for our tooling. Parquet is acceptable but not required.
- Control narratives: Operational narratives + screenshots are acceptable for initial review; for any gaps we'll request owner-signed attestations later in the process.

One ask: MountainGuard will want a short list of 10 representative users for privilege-change sampling (not PII, just user ids and timestamps). Please let us know the best person to coordinate for that dataset.

I'll also attach the sampling spec from MountainGuard so you can map fields.

Best,
Elaine
Elaine Wu
Sr. Information Security Manager
Acme Corp

Attachments: mg-sampling-spec.pdf (12KB)

From: audit-team@mountainguard.com <audit-team@mountainguard.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Audit scope probing and sample requests — ISO/FedRAMP intake

Hello Sofia / Elaine,

Thanks for the clarifications. A few probing questions to avoid rework later: 
1) KMS evidence: we require the key rotation schedule, rotation logs for the last 12 months, and a signed control owner attestation that rotation adhered to the policy for sampled keys. Can you confirm where rotation logs reside (Cloud KMS/Audit logs) and whether rotation events include user/service principal IDs?

2) Telemetry retention: confirm whether your retention policy is configured via infra-as-code (we'll ask for the repo link) and whether soft-delete or immutable retention is enabled for the log bucket.

3) Snapshotting: for live exports we prefer a pre-signed URL to an object store (S3/GCS) rather than a streamed session. If you provide a manifest, include sha256 checksums.

4) Time synchronization: provide the NTP configuration and a short summary of time-drift monitoring (alerts/owner).

Please upload the 90-day auth/priv-change sample and a short manifest to the Drive link shared in Sofia's original message by COB Tuesday (1/20). If you hit blockers, flag them and we'll triage.

Regards,
MountainGuard Assessments
Assessment Lead
